overview: Vex Thal Approach is the ascendant threshold between Luclin’s subterranean abyss and the planar realm of Vex Thal. It blends cavern structures with Akhevan resonance architecture.
history: The Shissar discovered resonance currents leading toward Vex Thal.
Akhevan pylons were erected to stabilize planar transitions.
Void-light fractures opened after planar instability increased.
Thought Horrors attempted to invade the Approach but were repelled.
The Akheva sealed the final gate leading into Vex Thal.
hooks: A resonance surge destabilizes the Akhevan pylons.
Void-light fractures expand toward Abyssal Drop.
Shissar remnants attempt to breach the outer gate.
A Thought Horror queen senses the planar energy and moves to invade.
